eventMetadata.context_description: Latest official forecasts from Brazil’s National Institute of Meteorology and global models indicate a maximum of 22–23 °C for São Paulo on June 7, placing those outcomes at the center of trader consensus. Early austral winter conditions with light southeasterly flow, variable cloud cover, and limited daytime heating keep temperatures near the long-term June average high of roughly 22 °C. Minor differences in model runs regarding afternoon insolation and boundary-layer mixing create the tight spread between 23 °C and 24 °C.
